nodes.label: Architecture Decisions (DECISIONS.md)
nodes.rationale: Records durable decisions so coding agents do not repeatedly revisit settled choices.

nodes.label: D001 Python-first backend
nodes.rationale: Python for RAG/backend and Next.js/TypeScript for frontend.

nodes.label: D002 RAG as reusable internal package
nodes.rationale: RAG logic lives under packages/rag, separate from application code.

nodes.label: D003 Knowledge outside RAG package
nodes.rationale: Business/official knowledge, raw sources, evaluation datasets, prompts and experiment configs stay out of packages/rag.

nodes.label: D004 DocumentRepository abstraction
nodes.rationale: Ingestion obtains documents through DocumentRepository; Phase 1 LocalDocumentRepository, Phase 2 expected S3DocumentRepository.

nodes.label: D005 Documents are truth; chunks are derived
nodes.rationale: Documents and evaluation assets are versioned source entities; chunks, embeddings and indexes are derived artifacts.

nodes.label: D006 Authorization during retrieval
nodes.rationale: Access filters are server-created and applied before context construction/generation.

nodes.label: D007 Public-only Phase 1
nodes.rationale: Implement only guest/public retrieval now while retaining metadata/interface support for future scopes.

nodes.label: D008 Language and authorization are independent
nodes.rationale: Language applicability, content language, query language and access scope remain separate concepts.

nodes.label: D009 Source precedence
nodes.rationale: Owner-approved source for business policy; NAATI for official CCL rules; Home Affairs for migration/visa rules.

nodes.label: D010 Qdrant primary, SQLite FTS5 fallback
nodes.rationale: Qdrant for primary retrieval and SQLite FTS5 as authorization-preserving lexical fallback.

nodes.label: D011 BGE-M3 initial embeddings
nodes.rationale: Start with BGE-M3 for multilingual, low-cost experimentation.

nodes.label: D012 Bedrock Runtime for generation
nodes.rationale: Amazon Bedrock Runtime through an internal generator abstraction; no Bedrock Knowledge Bases/Agents/AgentCore in Phase 1.

nodes.label: D013 Git/YAML prompt versioning
nodes.rationale: Prompts are versioned repository assets; Langfuse records operational versions/traces.

nodes.label: D014 Evaluation Suite model
nodes.rationale: Goldens are one evaluation-case category inside a broader Evaluation Suite.

nodes.label: D015 Human-governed LLM suggestions
nodes.rationale: Phase 2 LLM evaluation suggestions are candidates only; admin may accept, edit+accept, reject or manually create a case.

nodes.label: D016 Knowledge Release model
nodes.rationale: Knowledge Release is an immutable active release; Knowledge Release Candidate during Phase 2 changes; references Document Snapshot, Evaluation Suite, RAG Config, Index Version.

nodes.label: D017 Phase 2 storage direction
nodes.rationale: S3 for immutable/versioned document bodies, metadata database for relationships/workflow/audit, Qdrant as derived retrieval index.

nodes.label: D018 Phase 2 analytics only
nodes.rationale: Define stable analytics event contracts in Phase 1; do not implement analytics pipelines/dashboard yet.

nodes.label: D019 Local uv-managed Python for setup
nodes.rationale: uv for environment setup and locking; make setup keeps uv cache and Python installs in ignored repo-local directories so it works in restricted agent environments.

nodes.label: D020 Local Qdrant image pin
nodes.rationale: Official qdrant/qdrant:v1.19.2 image; data in a named Docker volume keeps derived index state outside committed source.

nodes.label: D021 Portable spec-driven agent skills
nodes.rationale: SDD workflow encoded as Agent Skills; agent-skills/ is the only editable source, mirrored by sync script to .claude, .agents and .kiro; frontmatter stays portable.

nodes.label: D022 Spec approval and review state live in the repository
nodes.rationale: Status lines carry dated approvals; review results in review.md; failed review adds RM<N>.<k> tasks; amendments in Change log; no changes to evaluation/knowledge/config without approved task.

nodes.label: D023 Task-gated agent workflow
nodes.rationale: Replaces whole-spec implement-then-review with a per-task loop (orchestrator, implementer, task-reviewer, user approval); independence comes from a fresh session since a fork inherits the caller's model.

nodes.label: D024 Document repository, hashing and eligibility (Spec 002)
nodes.rationale: Protocol-based repository without physical paths; content-hash-v1 is the sole change signal; one explicit EligibilityPolicy; language rule only in DocumentQuery.matches; adds jsonschema and pyyaml.

nodes.label: D025 persona_scope is not loaded, indexed or hashed (Spec 004)
nodes.rationale: access_scope is the only authorization field; persona_scope stays informational until a persona spec adds it with content-hash-v2. Closes Spec 002 F2.

nodes.label: D026 Index payload rule and one version per document (Spec 004)
nodes.rationale: 17-field payload covered by content_hash, identity fields compared directly; one version per document_id replaced wholesale; UUIDv5 point IDs under a permanent namespace; slugify rules for stable section IDs.

nodes.label: D027 Optional BGE-M3 dependency (Spec 004)
nodes.rationale: sentence-transformers/PyTorch in optional bge-m3 extra with model pinned to a commit SHA so verify, CI and unit tests need no PyTorch, Docker or download; missing extra detected at embedder construction.

nodes.label: D028 Index settings mismatch refusal and rebuild by new index_version (Spec 004)
nodes.rationale: Index-defining settings stored in a companion settings collection; mismatch refused with exit 2 and no writes; changes require a new index_version; store never deletes collections.

nodes.label: D029 Ingestion reads state from Qdrant, no separate state store (Spec 004)
nodes.rationale: Payload records what was indexed; ingestion classifies documents added/updated/unchanged, deletes ineligible ones, continues past per-document failures; exit codes 0/1/2.

nodes.label: D030 Baseline chunking differs from day1_baseline.yaml on purpose (Spec 004)
nodes.rationale: Heading/section chunking with 2000-character cap avoids coupling the chunker to a tokenizer; seed documents yield one chunk either way; recursive/semantic chunking deferred to the chunking roadmap item.

nodes.label: D031 Required retrospective that reconciles documentation
nodes.rationale: Supersedes optional retrospective of D023: spec-reviewer runs for every spec and reconciles docs with code as built; a spec is verified only after PASS, user approval and merge.

nodes.label: D032 Spec 004 retrospective corrections to D026 and D027
nodes.rationale: Corrects wording only: identity fields are exactly four; D026 decides but does not fully close F4; bge-m3 is an optional-dependencies extra, not a PEP 735 group.

nodes.label: D033 AccessContext and Role live in core; guest resolver returns identical policy object (Spec 005)
nodes.rationale: Frozen AccessContext(role, tenant_id) carries no scopes or language; resolve_access is the only role-to-policy mapping and guest returns the same GUEST_PUBLIC_POLICY used by ingestion.

nodes.label: D034 W2A_TENANT_ID is a server setting (Spec 005)
nodes.rationale: Tenant comes from server setting; empty refused; shared load_runtime_settings loader names only env var names; no CLI flag or query field can set role, scope or tenant.

nodes.label: D035 One filter builder, a fail-closed re-check, and the same path for later fallbacks (Spec 005)
nodes.rationale: build_access_filter is the only filter builder; check_hit re-validates every hit and raises RetrievalAuthorizationError; later fallbacks must reuse the same path with no second policy.

nodes.label: D036 Query-embedder binding is read-only and compares embedder fields only (Spec 005)
nodes.rationale: DenseIndex.open never writes and compares five embedder fields; chunker fields describe document splitting not query embedding; fake vs real mismatch refused.

nodes.label: D037 Baseline result format (Spec 005)
nodes.rationale: retrieval_baseline 1.0 JSON: declared not verified release, random expectation min(1,k/N), warm-up excluded, no query/chunk text, fake refused without --allow-fake, never overwritten.

nodes.label: D038 The embedding device is recorded, not pinned, and not an index setting (Spec 005)
nodes.rationale: Device recorded after warm-up but not compared or pinned; cross-machine reproducibility (mps vs cpu) left to later work.

nodes.label: D039 make lint checks formatting (Spec 005)
nodes.rationale: make lint runs ruff check and ruff format --check; UV_HTTP_TIMEOUT defaults to 300; closes Spec 004 observations.

nodes.label: D040 Authorization is applied inside every retriever, before fusion (Spec 005 retrospective; extends D035)
nodes.rationale: Every retrieval leg applies the filter inside its own query and calls check_hit; RRF, reranking and context building only see authorized hits; never after fusion, rerank or generation.

nodes.label: D041 Payload-derived text is printed only through safe_text (Spec 005)
nodes.rationale: Payload text is untrusted; safe_text strips ANSI and bidi controls, collapses whitespace, keeps ZWNJ/ZWJ for Malayalam; reused by all printers.

nodes.label: D042 Governed suite loader, validator and schema files (Spec 006)
nodes.rationale: Evaluation assets read only through suite.py, tolerant loader, strict validation in make validate-evaluation; only active suites run; candidates never loaded as cases; Malayalam candidate review flags.

nodes.label: D043 Result format 2.0 for retrieval evaluation; compare still reads 1.0 (Spec 006)
nodes.rationale: retrieval_evaluation 2.0 keeps D037 keys and adds suite block, slices, small_sample flags, section metrics and unanswerable score distribution; IDs and counts only; fake refused.

nodes.label: D044 Quality gate for eval-compare (Spec 006)
nodes.rationale: Constant gate: fail on more than 1 fewer hit or MRR drop above 1/n; flips, slices and latency reported only; differing suite/case set/top_k/fake refused with exit 2.

nodes.label: D045 Security gate construction (Spec 006)
nodes.rationale: make eval-security builds a throwaway in-memory w2a-sectest collection with fake embedder and forbidden points at each query vector; unfiltered sanity check; top_k 50; any forbidden return is a violation.

nodes.label: D046 Legacy make retrieval-baseline stays frozen (Spec 006)
nodes.rationale: metrics.py, baseline.py and baseline_cli.py unchanged; goldens.py becomes a wrapper; characterization test against frozen fixture copy keeps output byte-for-byte identical.

nodes.label: D047 Security evaluation result format 1.0 and throwaway output location (Spec 006)
nodes.rationale: security_evaluation 1.0 with IDs, counts and verdicts only, written exclusively on pass or violation to git-ignored experiments/results/tmp/.

nodes.label: D048 graphify knowledge graph for coding agents (developer tooling)
nodes.rationale: Developer tooling building a committed graph in graphify-out/; project-scope skill and PreToolUse hooks; git hooks not used because they conflict with commit-on-approval; graph is a navigation aid, files are the truth.

nodes.label: D049 Suite public-eval-v2 and the closed v1 reference (Spec 007)
nodes.rationale: v2 (91 cases) copies v1 unchanged plus six owner-approved Malayalam goldens g064-g069; v1 replaced so its result file is a closed reference; g004 kept beside u001.

nodes.label: D050 SQLite FTS5 lexical store, not Qdrant sparse vectors (Spec 007)
nodes.rationale: FTS5 is standard library, already the planned fallback store and avoids a second sparse model; ascii tokenizer over lexical-v1 tokens because unicode61 splits Malayalam; per-collection derived file bound to the dense identity.

nodes.label: D051 Tokenizer lexical-v1 (Spec 007)
nodes.rationale: NFC, drop ZWJ/ZWNJ, lowercase, keep L*, N*, Mn, Mc; no stemming or stopwords; matches slugify; legacy chillu sequences do not match atomic chillu; queries capped at 64 terms.

nodes.label: D052 Reciprocal Rank Fusion and HybridRetriever (Spec 007)
nodes.rationale: Pure rrf_fuse with k 60, equal weights, candidate depth 50 from config/retrieval.yaml; same ResolvedAccess per leg; fails closed with no single-leg fallback; Strategy vocabulary and build_retriever.

nodes.label: D053 Result format 2.1 and security result 1.1 (Spec 007)
nodes.rationale: retrieval_evaluation 2.1 adds strategy, fusion, lexical index, leg ranks and truncation; security 1.1 gates dense, bm25 and hybrid against throwaway Qdrant and lexical file with per-leg sanity checks.

nodes.label: D054 eval-compare identity rules (Spec 007)
nodes.rationale: Refuses differing collection, index_version, embedder or lexical identity; a different strategy is allowed so dense, bm25 and hybrid runs compare under the unchanged gate.

nodes.label: D055 Default strategy is hybrid (Spec 007)
nodes.rationale: Real runs 2026-10-28 on public-eval-v2: dense 66 hits MRR 0.8816, bm25 64 hits MRR 0.7082 fails gate, hybrid 68 hits MRR 0.9094 passes with only miss-to-hit flips; R13 rule holds so default_strategy hybrid; makes lexical file required.

nodes.label: Chunks, embeddings and indexes as derived artifacts
